spanish: Y el interior y las piernas lavará en las aguas, y acercará el sacerdote el todo, y hará humear hacia el altar; holocausto él, ofrenda de fuego, olor de reposo a Jehová.

findings.issue: אִשֵּׁה and רֵיחַ are construct, so the chain is one genitive: fire-offering of an odor of rest. The comma drops that link and lines the phrases up as separate items.
findings.spanishSpan: ofrenda de fuego, olor de reposo

findings.issue: Dual absolute is smoothed to a Spanish plural; the paired number is not marked.

notes: Remaining clauses match person, stem, articles, he-locale, verbless הוּא, and Jehová.
